## 2025–2026 Programme

The "Patagonia & Chilean Fjords" itinerary is operated north to south, and south to north, depending on the departure date. Ensure that you are clear on the embarkation and disembarkation ports of your departure. The expedition starts at the pier as indicated in the itinerary. Boarding opens at 15:00 hrs. and closes at 16:00 hrs. On the last day of the expedition, disembarkation is planned for the morning as indicated in the itinerary, with the trip ending at the pier
